notes: NOT an Ambiguous Match - there is only one candidate, and he is very probably the right man; the problem is that NO OFFICIAL source publishes him, so the band cannot honestly go above Low. WHAT WAS FOUND: he is published as 'Dr. K Ashwanth' (the Telugu initial convention, where K = Kolluri), and the assigned facts line up across two corroborating-only directories: Practo (https://www.practo.com/hyderabad/doctor/dr-k-ashwanth-orthopedist) gives name + specialty (Orthopedic surgeon, MBBS + MS Orthopaedics) + city (Hyderabad), and a JustDial listing titled verbatim 'Dr. K Ashwanth (Gleneagles Aware Hospital) - Hyderabad ... Beside Aware College Of Nursing Engineering Saroor Nagar' gives name + hospital + the correct LB Nagar/Saroor Nagar locality. Taken together that is name + specialty + hospital + city, i.e. the section-2 identity test is met. WHY THE BAND IS STILL LOW: neither Practo nor JustDial is an official source, and SEVEN queries produced ZERO official confirmation. Specifically, THREE separate WebSearches restricted to allowed_domains=['gleneagleshospitals.co.in'] - on 'Ashwanth' + orthopaedics, on 'Ashwanth' + LB Nagar, and on 'Kolluri' + joint replacement - returned NO page for him, although that site clearly does publish per-doctor pages in the family https://www.gleneagleshospitals.co.in/hyderabad/lb-nagar/doctors/dr-<name>-orthopaedics-joint-replacement-surgeon (confirmed live for Dr Ashwin Kumar Reddy at the same branch and department). No page was constructed from that pattern. Also searched: 'Ashwanth Chowdary', 'Ashwanth Kolluri', LinkedIn, and a knee-replacement angle - nothing. The name element 'Chowdary' appears on NO indexed page for him. HOSPITAL_PROFILE IS DELIBERATELY BLANK for that reason. WHAT A HUMAN SHOULD CHECK: (1) confirm on the Gleneagles LB Nagar doctor listing that a Dr K Ashwanth / Kolluri Ashwanth Chowdary is currently on the orthopaedics roster - the roster names that DID surface for that department were Dr Ashwin Kumar Reddy, Dr M Ashwin Kumar, Dr JVS Vidya Sagar and Dr V V Satyanarayana E, none of them him; (2) beware the near-miss names in this specialty and city - 'Dr Ashwin Kumar Reddy' and 'Dr M Ashwin Kumar' are BOTH orthopaedic/joint-replacement doctors at the SAME Gleneagles LB Nagar branch, and 'Dr Gowtham Chowdary Kankanala' is a separate senior Hyderabad orthopaedic surgeon - none of these were merged into this record. CONTACTS: all blank. The JustDial listing carries a number, but JustDial numbers are call-tracking proxies and are rejected outright by the brief, so it was not recorded and the JustDial URL itself was left out rather than dressed up as a profile.
